topic: Closing your oldest credit card can drop your score, because it shortens your average account age
title: Why Closing Your Oldest Credit Card Hurts Your Score
description:
You think you're being responsible by closing an old, unused credit card. But the credit bureaus see it differently, and your score can drop as a result.
